errors.evidence: The 'Inconsistency-CE' line does not start at AL 0.0; its first data point is at approximately AL 0.7. The BLEU score at that point is approximately 20.1, not 18.8.
The 'Inconsistency-CE' line ends at AL 10.0 with a BLEU score of approximately 27.2. The value 26.3 corresponds to the data point at AL 7.5.
The line for 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' is described as a solid line, but it is a dashed line in the plot.
The 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' line begins at AL 0.0 with a BLEU score of approximately 18.5, not 19.3.
The 'Inconsistency-CE-MP' line ends at AL 10.0 with a BLEU score of approximately 27.3, making the reported value of 26.8 inaccurate.
The line for 'Consistency-Bi' is described as a dashed line, but it is a solid line in the plot.
The 'Consistency-Bi' line does not start at AL 0.0; its first data point is at approximately AL 0.7.

The 'Consistency-Bi' line ends at AL 10.0 with a BLEU score of approximately 28.5, not 28.2. Furthermore, this line does not simply increase; it peaks at approximately AL 9.0 (BLEU ~28.7) and then slightly declines to its final point.
